svg.title: Fragment
svg.desc: Auto-measured fragment: split ClientHello, measured network, three tiers, live check
svg.text: The panel measures your browser, then splits the TLS ClientHello to match
فرگمنت خودکار، متناسب با کیفیت شبکه‌ی شما
Settings → test sites, rotated: each run takes the next 3 of 9
Live check from your browser: a WebSocket to each endpoint must answer. A protocol that does not answer
gets no fragment. VMess links and plain non-TLS configs have nothing to fragment.
